gaps.title: Connected multiplayer
gaps.reason: Authenticated YOG lobby, multiplayer waiting room, game-connection progress, populated online map browser and transfer progress require controlled network fixtures. No live account or other player was used.

gaps.title: Loading and failure transitions
gaps.reason: Preview loading/error fixtures are included. Fertility progress, persistence failure/retry/export, disconnection and cancellation transitions still require dedicated staged jobs or fault injection.

gaps.title: Device-owned UI
gaps.reason: Android/iOS keyboards, notches/safe areas, document pickers, permission prompts and lifecycle overlays require simulator/device captures.

gaps.title: Additional state variants
gaps.reason: This covers named views, not every permutation: alternate building/flag types, populated message history, additional dropdowns and intermediate scroll positions remain to be captured.

gaps.title: Presentation modes
gaps.reason: The frontend adapts phone and tablet composition separately. Desktop captures use mouse controls at 1280×800 and 1920×1080. Language variants, accessibility scales and device-specific input combinations remain outside this image matrix.
